mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 2.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in consumer spending (RSAFS) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal economic overheating that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both RSAFS and CPIAUCSL increase by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: During supply shock regimes characterized by declining industrial production (INDPRO), manufacturing output contraction reduces corporate profits and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO falls by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic expansion that drives corporate investment growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5%, it indicates a tight labor market that fuels wage growth and consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases (FEDFUNDS) and payroll declines (PAYEMS) signal economic slowdown amid tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening during labor market slowdown
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS increases by at least 0.25% and PAYEMS decreases by at least 0.3% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) increase equity discount rates and reduce liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is rising (by at least 0.25% in the last month).
